about: Setup-token (Anthropic OAuth) request shaping, as the extension does it in background.ts:
rewriteToolNamesForClaudeCode, then injectClaudeCodeSystemPrompt relocating the system prompt only

case-insensitively. Regenerate "expected" from core after a deliberate change, then sync mobile.js.
